title: 第四章 天阙长城
content_zh:
半空中尘洗月抓雨为刀，对着巨蛇一刀劈下，刀上水光流转，气如潮奔，双眼中杀气凛冽。

    一股酒香传来，紧接着强大的刀意自天而强，巨蛇身上的鳞片瞬间膨胀，变得又宽又厚，紧紧地将它包裹住。

    厚厚的鳞片将尘洗月的攻击完全挡住，尘洗月无比凌厉地一刀砍在鳞片上，竟然连痕迹都没留下。

    尘洗月嘴角泛出一丝轻蔑的笑意，一刀之后，就停了下来。习惯性地摸了摸腰间，才发现已经没有了酒壶。

    巨蛇以为尘洗月，面对自己的防御毫无办法。还没来得及得意，就感到体内隐隐传来一阵阵细痛，鳞片下的皮肉交接处，犹如钢针在游走。

    初始只是寥寥数只时，并未在意，这转眼的工夫，就有全身上下都是。

    一缕缕刀气，沿着巨蛇皮肉相连处四散游走，一寸寸地割断它的皮肉，慢慢地往体内渗透。此时巨蛇大脑里只有一个词“磔杀”。

    磔杀，夏人最残酷的刑罚之一，俗称千刀万剐。技艺高明的施刑者，据说能让受刑者身中3600刀，而保留五感，能让受刑者清楚感受到，肉一片片离开自己的身体。

    巨蛇此刻就是这样，感受着自己的皮肉一点点被剥开，蛇皮一厘一寸地离开自己的躯体。

    在尘洗月舔了舔嘴唇，心中叹息道：“唉，这种时候能喝上两口就好了。”可想到雨亦浓就在后面，不禁一阵胆寒，想法迅速消去。

    停止求雨的雨归尘和雨亦浓已经来到尘小楼旁边，遭受巨蛇重击的尘小楼满头鲜血，原本蒙在眼睛的红布条也斜挂在一边。雨归尘心疼地将布条扶正，用衣袖擦了擦尘小楼身上的血迹。

    看到尘小楼的模样，雨亦浓大怒，对着尘洗月喊道：“宰了这畜生，老娘让你畅饮一天，要是出现幺蛾子，老娘就把你埋在桃花林的酒，全部挖出来丢到叶玉江里去。”

    尘洗月心中突然一惊，暗道：“不好，我的桃花酿啊！！”磅礴的气从体内涌出，尘洗月周围桃花飞舞，落英缤纷。

    这是天人境成功合道后的天象显现，只有全力以赴的情况才会出现。

    尘洗月刀如奔雷，掺杂着阵阵潮声，不过并未斩向巨蛇，而是朝巨蛇旁边的地下砍去。

    尘洗月砍向的位置，地面泥土突然外翻，一阵股蓝色液体从泥土中喷向尘洗月。尘洗月连忙侧身躲闪，液体落在地上冒出一阵青烟，竟将泥土腐蚀出一个小坑。

    “好厉害的毒。”

    暴露的怪物在地下开始快速移动，怪物移动过的地方，地面上犹如犁过一般。片刻之后尘洗月周围的地面布满了交织纵横的沟堑。

    在尘洗月专心应付地下的时候，原本摊在地上的巨蛇，突然抬起头，瞪向尘洗月，猛地跃起张开大口，带着一阵毒雾，朝尘洗月咬去。

    尘洗月喝道：“找死”

    弯身横刀，朝巨蛇最薄弱的肚皮砍去。

    水刀过处，巨蛇的躯体被划成两截，后半段轻飘飘地落在地上。尘洗月发现，掉在地上的就是一张蛇皮，里面没有半点血肉。

    尘洗月暗叫：“不好”。

    一股掺杂着腥臭味的暖风从身后传来，与此同时，一条赤褐色的蜈蚣从地下破土而出，脑袋上的钳子张开，唆的一下插进尘洗月胸口。

    眼看钳子穿透尘洗月的身体，蜈蚣将钳子朝外一扯，想将尘洗月撕开。一扯之下，尘洗月的身体突然变成一团桃花，轰然炸开后，飞到旁边重新汇聚在一起，尘洗月持刀从桃花中隐现出来。

    此时的巨蛇狼狈至极，为了保命而强行脱皮，半张旧皮挂在身体上，表面上的新皮还未长成，表面到处都是撕扯出来的肉丝，可以肉眼看见，表面的肌肉在不停地颤动。
content_en:
The dusty moon in mid-air grabbed the rain and used it as a knife, and slashed it at the giant snake. The water on the knife flowed, the energy flowed like a tide, and the eyes were filled with murderous intent.

    There was a smell of wine, and then a powerful sword force came from the sky. The scales on the giant snake instantly expanded, becoming wide and thick, wrapping it tightly.

    The thick scales completely blocked Chen Xinyue's attack. Chen Xinyue slashed the scales with an extremely sharp knife, leaving no trace at all.

    A contemptuous smile appeared at the corner of Chen Xiyue's mouth, and after one stab, he stopped. I touched my waist out of habit, only to find that the wine bottle was no longer there.

    The giant snake thought that Chen Xiyue was helpless against its own defense. Before he could feel proud, he felt faint pains in his body, and the junction of skin and flesh under the scales felt like steel needles moving around.

    At first, there were only a few of them, so I didn't pay much attention to them. In the blink of an eye, they were all over my body.

    Wisps of knife energy spread along the joints between the giant snake's skin and flesh, cutting off its skin and flesh inch by inch, and slowly penetrated into the body. At this time, there was only one word in the giant snake's brain: "kill".

    Killing is one of the most cruel punishments practiced by the Xia people, commonly known as being cut into pieces by a thousand cuts. A skilled torturer is said to be able to inflict 3,600 knives on the victim, while retaining the five senses, allowing the victim to clearly feel the flesh leaving his body piece by piece.

    The giant snake was like this at the moment, feeling its skin being peeled off bit by bit, and the snake skin leaving its body inch by inch.

    Zai Chen Xiyue licked his lips and sighed in his heart: "Oh, it would be nice if I could have a few sips at this time." But thinking that Yu Yinong was behind him, he couldn't help but feel frightened, and the thought quickly disappeared.

    Yu Guichen and Yu Yinong, who had stopped praying for rain, had already arrived next to Chen Xiaolou. Chen Xiaolou, who had been hit hard by the giant snake, was covered in blood, and the red cloth strips that were originally covering his eyes were hanging sideways. Yu Guichen straightened the cloth in distress and wiped the blood on Chen Xiaolou's body with his sleeve.

    Seeing the appearance of Chen Xiaolou, Yu Yinong was furious and shouted to Chen Xiyue: "Kill this beast, I will let you drink as much as you want for a day. If anything happens, I will dig up all the wine you buried in the peach blossom forest and throw it into Ye Yujiang."

    Chen Xiyue was suddenly startled, and said to herself: "No, my peach blossom brew!!" Powerful Qi surged out of her body, peach blossoms were flying around Chen Xiyue, and fallen flowers were in full bloom.

    This is the celestial phenomenon that appears after the heaven and human realm successfully merge. It will only appear if you go all out.

    The dust-washing moon knife was like thunder, mixed with the sound of waves, but it did not slash towards the giant snake, but towards the ground next to the giant snake.

    Where Chen Xiyue was cutting, the soil on the ground suddenly turned outwards, and bursts of blue liquid sprayed from the soil towards Chen Xiyue. Chen Xiyue quickly dodged sideways, and the liquid fell on the ground and emitted a burst of green smoke, corroding the soil into a small pit.

    "What a powerful poison."

    The exposed monster began to move quickly underground. Wherever the monster moved, the ground seemed to be plowed. After a while, the ground around Chen Xiyue was covered with criss-crossing ravines.

    While Chen Xiyue was concentrating on dealing with the underground, the giant snake that was originally lying on the ground suddenly raised its head, stared at Chen Xiyue, jumped up suddenly, opened its mouth, and bit Chen Xiyue with a burst of poisonous mist.

    Chen Xiyue shouted: "Looking for death"

    He bent down and slashed with the sword towards the snake's weakest belly.

    Wherever the water jet passed, the giant snake's body was cut into two parts, and the second half fell lightly to the ground. Chen Xiyue discovered that what fell on the ground was a piece of snake skin without any flesh and blood inside.

    Chen Xiyue secretly shouted: "Not good".

    A warm wind mixed with a fishy smell came from behind, and at the same time, an auburn centipede emerged from the ground, the pincers on its head opened, and it thrust into Chen Xiyue's chest.

    Seeing the pliers penetrate Chen Xiyue's body, Centipede pulled the pliers outward, trying to tear Chen Xiyue apart. With a pull, Chen Xinyue's body suddenly turned into a ball of peach blossoms. After exploding with a bang, it flew to the side and reunited. Chen Xinyue emerged from the peach blossoms holding a knife.

    At this time, the giant snake was extremely embarrassed. It had shed its skin forcibly in order to save its life. Half of its old skin was hanging on its body. The new skin on the surface had not yet grown. There were torn shreds of flesh everywhere on the surface. You could see with the naked eye that the muscles on the surface were constantly trembling.
